propositions: The review bot computes per-call LLM token usage (_usage with input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens) in the runner but discards these fields during code review, recording no token counts in retrievable form.

Token usage aggregation must be added to _attach_code_review_metrics in finalize.py to sum token fields across all _usage-bearing succeeded steps (Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide) into coverage.metrics.

_publish_token_usage_metrics must emit five CloudWatch metrics (review_bot_llm_input_tokens, review_bot_llm_output_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_read_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_write_tokens, review_bot_llm_total_tokens) to Namespace "rebar/host" as best-effort, never failing the vote.
Pass-1 finder batch token usage is explicitly out of scope and deferred to a follow-up ticket; this change covers agent-step usage only (Pass-2 and Pass-3).
The token publisher must swallow boto3 import, credential, and network errors without raising, matching the existing error-metric publisher contract.
